scope: Real-browser full-stack deterministic combat fixtures only; no research games, pilots, final evaluation or sanctioned results.

cases.title: accept default damage assignment — lethal to blocker, excess to player
cases.initial: Blistering Firecat7/1 trample haste attacks; Glory Seeker2/2 blocks;20life each, one Mountain library each.
cases.actions: Real attack/block UI; Confirm Damage without changing defaults.
cases.expected: Glory Seeker leaves battlefield; defender15life; existing screenshots retained.

cases.title: custom damage assignment — put extra damage on blocker
cases.actions: Real attack/block UI; decrease player damage2 then increase Glory Seeker2; Confirm Damage.
cases.expected: Glory Seeker dies, defender17life (4creature+3player). All old assertions unchanged.

cases.title: no damage assignment for non-trample creature blocked by single blocker
cases.initial: Hill Giant3/3 attacks; Glory Seeker2/2 blocks;20life each, one Mountain library each.
cases.actions: Real attack/block UI; automatic sole assignment.
cases.expected: Glory Seeker dies; Hill Giant survives; defender20life; all old assertions unchanged.

cases.title: ordinary damage can split one and one without making either blocker lethal
cases.initial: Grizzly Bears2/2 attacks, blocked by Glory Seeker2/2 and Hill Giant3/3,20life each, one Mountain library each.
cases.actions: Actual attack/block controls. Assert assignment board, no legacy Order Blockers prompt. Lower engine default amount on Glory Seeker from2to1, raise Hill Giant from0to1; assert displayed1/1 and Confirm Damage.
cases.expected: Both blockers survive, Grizzly Bears dies to their full combined5 damage, defender20life. Actual free nonlethal split, no submitted order map or injected engine state.

stopping: Every fail/error/skip/missing case or incomplete artifact/guard blocks acceptance; preserve first attempt. No retry/reroll. Root may authorize a source-versioned diagnosed successor.
excluded_existing_case: multiple-blockers.spec.ts assumes obsolete OrderBlockersDecision; preserved and not selected. It is not silently counted as valid current-rules coverage.
ui_scope: CombatDamageManager currently only creates CombatResolutionDecision for real choices; no production AssignDamageDecision constructor was found.

Therefore actual browser cases qualify CombatResolutionBoard. CombatDamageAssignmentModal remains source/typecheck-only compatibility UI unless a genuine current engine route is separately demonstrated. Do not inject a fake decision to claim mechanics coverage.
entropy: Scenario API has no caller seed field. These are fixed board/action browser fixtures, not randomized matchup samples; backend-generated entity/session/routing identifiers are retained in actual logs/traces when available. One identical basic library card each removes shuffle/draw identity ambiguity for this combat. No seed namespace or completed research allocation is consumed.

execution_plan.platform: Project-scoped workflow_dispatch CI on exact github.sha, clean checkout, read-only permissions, no secrets or publication step
execution_plan.dependencies: npm ci exact committed locks in web-client and e2e-scenarios; locked Playwright Chromium installed; JDK21 and Node22 version/paths recorded; exact source and lock guards before and after
execution_plan.browser_command: cd e2e-scenarios && npx --no-install playwright test --config ferocity-combat.config.ts
execution_plan.artifacts: stdout/stderr, JUnit+JSON+HTML reports, test-result screenshots/video/trace if generated, source/runtime manifest, exit codes and final source guard. No actual local session credentials provided.
execution_plan.local_observation: node24.19.0/npm11.9.0 available; no system Chromium found. No npm dependency install, browser install, server, or browser test was run locally by author.
